About Me

Two Decades of Building Wealth & Changing Lives

With over 20 years of experience spanning finance, credit analysis, business development, and investment advisory, I've built a career at the intersection of capital and opportunity.

I specialize in real estate investments, credit insurance, and a full spectrum of financing solutions — including hard and soft money lending, asset-based lending, and factoring. Throughout my career, I've partnered with business owners, investors, and financial advisers at some of the nation's most respected investment firms.

Today, through Nork Group and Nork Capital Lending, I bring that same expertise directly to real estate investors — sourcing off-market wholesale deals across Florida and providing fast, flexible hard money lending for fix-and-flip, buy-and-hold, and acquisition strategies.

Real Estate Coaching

Why You Need a Real Estate Coach

Breaking into real estate investing can feel overwhelming, especially when you're navigating complex market dynamics, endless strategies, and real financial risks on your own. That's why so many successful investors turn to structured coaching programs — they provide a proven path to accelerate success while avoiding costly mistakes.

Real estate coaching bridges the gap between theory and real-world execution. Books, videos, and seminars give you information — but information alone isn't enough. You need guidance, accountability, and a step-by-step plan tailored specifically to your goals and market.

The best coaching programs offer direct mentorship, real-world deal analysis, and ongoing support — not just a textbook or generic course. They provide hands-on training so you can take action, close deals, and start building wealth right away.

With the right guidance, you're not just learning how to invest — you're actively building a personalized roadmap to get you where you want to be. Whether starting with fix-and-flip, new construction, commercial, or long-term rentals, the right coaching is the difference between years of struggle and a fast track to financial freedom.
